revocation.reason: The frozen guide PNG failed the protected-return pixel gate after the initial QA verdict: 0/11 sampled points on each complete return had any stroke-colored pixel in a 5x5 neighborhood, while the tower-outline control passed 11/11.
revocation.root_cause: Later opaque hall and roof layers overpaint the protected boundary layer.

authority.user_scope: The current user request explicitly authorizes generation of every needed Career World concept asset and encourages autonomous parallel art and QA lanes.
authority.director_decision: The independently accepted deterministic ContextForge guide may condition exactly one fresh built-in imagegen call under the frozen D-014 prompt.

sole_referenced_input.role: Deterministic geometry and composition guide only; these same frozen bytes remain the fallback candidate.

single_authorized_call.prompt_source: Join `guided_call_contract.exact_prompt_lines` from the frozen D-014 report with one LF, no trailing LF, UTF-8 without BOM.
forbidden_inputs: Any generated or raster image other than the one frozen guide PNG

report_must_freeze: Execution packet, D-014 prompt, guide, and output byte/hash receipts
Exact imagegen argument keys and values
Call count, retry count, generator identity, and tool outcome
PNG dimensions, channels, and storage/runtime-isolation receipts
No generator acceptance or promotion decision

required_after_call: Dispatch a different independent non-generator reviewer for the same nine frozen gates.
If the guided candidate passes, return it to the Director as promotion-eligible only.
If the guided candidate fails, make no new generation or edit call; dispatch a different independent reviewer for the already-frozen fallback PNG.
Do not release the remaining eight until ContextForge resolves and the Director issues a separate release.
explicitly_not_authorized: Any second imagegen call, edit, composite, paintover, CLI/API generation, or 3D fallback
Any mutation of the guide SVG or PNG
Any release of the remaining eight D-013 assets
Any runtime, product, test, queue, ledger, or architecture mutation
Any Git staging, commit, push, deployment, or external publication
stop_conditions: Any frozen prompt, guide, plan, generation, or QA receipt drifts.
The output candidate exists before the call.
The built-in imagegen call errors or returns an unusable output; no retry is authorized.
Any requested action exceeds this one-call fence.
